column1: # The Rust API's access windows over zones (spacelab::access::zone_sgp4_windows and zone_tabulated_windows), to the bit (Ф31.C).
# Written by crates/spacelab/tests/bridge_access_zone.rs; the C ABI and the Python bridge must reproduce it. A double is the 16 hex digits of its bits.

# Angles are radians; positions are ITRF metres, velocities metres per second, and times seconds past the start label (SGP4) or the table's own. A zone is its vertices, counter-clockwise seen from outside. Rows, tab-separated:
#   sgp4    <case> <any|all> <mask rad> <tol s> <TLE line 1> <TLE line 2> <EOP path from the repository root | none> <year> <month> <day> <hour> <minute> <second> <span s>
